doc.title: Joe Wilder Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 12, 1998

title: Closing questions and advice to listen to his recordings
summary: Rowe thanks Wilder, asks if anything is missing, and urges him to listen to his own recordings.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well it’s been fascinating talking to you again.
Well you certainly put me at ease.
Anything that I haven’t asked you that you’d like to —
Well I think we’ve covered quite a bit. When we get off we’ll probably think of a hundred other things that we might have touched on.
But I do think you should go home and listen to some of your own recordings.
